mechanism_findings.finding: Project-Frankenstein's February Adaptive Visual Pipeline implemented conditional-compute routing rather than adaptive learning: YOLO/OCR/scene heuristics always ran first, an explicit confidence/trigger engine decided whether a slower VLM was needed, and per-path timing/save-rate statistics were recorded.
mechanism_findings.current_mapping: Reusable-with-adaptation ancestor of Retina cheap-gate/familiar-fast-path routing and resource instrumentation.

mechanism_findings.finding: The Stage-1 path emitted structured evidence fields such as objects, OCR text, scene confidence, screenshot/photo/diagram flags and image size before any generative interpretation.
mechanism_findings.current_mapping: Preserve structured sensor receipts beneath any learned familiarity or native-VLM interpretation so model prose does not become sensor truth.

mechanism_findings.finding: The adaptive-routing implementation was deliberately removed when FrankEye became the unified vision path, and FrankEye was later itself replaced by direct Qwen3.5 native multimodal inference.
mechanism_findings.current_mapping: Backbone/perception implementations are historically volatile; MVC state therefore needs explicit feature-backbone compatibility, invalidation/migration and rollback semantics.

mechanism_findings.finding: Frozen-head native_vision directly sends the whole image to Qwen3.5 and exposes describe/deep/OCR prompts, but contains no persistent user-specific prototype/classifier memory, training-example trust tier, candidate promotion, calibration/open-set state or rollback loop.
mechanism_findings.current_mapping: NativeVision is a deeper perception/escalation backend, not an implementation of the owner-fixed adaptive Micro Visual Classifier.

mechanism_findings.finding: Project-Frankenstein contributes a strong historical routing/gating lineage while Drive Digital Retina contributes learned centroid/dictionary and replay lineage; the two are complementary rather than duplicate implementations.
mechanism_findings.current_mapping: Best evidence-preserving inheritance candidate is cheap change/structured gate -> reusable frozen feature -> user-specific MVC/prototypes -> calibrated open-set gate -> familiar fast path or deeper native Retina/Qwen vision escalation. This is an architecture inference to test, not a promoted live result.

negative_results_and_failure_modes: Historical Project-Frankenstein 'adaptive vision' must not be misclassified as user-adaptive learning; its adaptation was routing/escalation only.

The earlier YOLO/OCR path inherits known class-boundary, stylized-text and detector-hallucination failure modes documented in the Drive Digital Retina lineage; therefore it cannot be semantic authority.
The frozen-head NativeVision path lacks an explicit calibrated open-set/familiarity contract and does not by itself satisfy MVC-E2 through MVC-E7.
Repeated replacement of visual backbones means user-learned classifier/prototype state can silently become incompatible unless backbone/version migration is first-class.
A direct VLM description can be useful but does not replace structured sensor-evidence provenance or known/unknown/conflict routing.

cross_source_reconciliation.drive_retina_lineage: learned GoL-signature cluster centers/prototype-like dictionary, replay/miss loop, realistic-negative threshold calibration and documented false-positive/coverage tradeoffs
cross_source_reconciliation.project_frankenstein_lineage: structured fast visual gate, confidence-triggered conditional VLM compute, then FrankEye consolidation, then native-Qwen multimodal consolidation
cross_source_reconciliation.deduplication: No duplicate earned-work hours assigned. Drive learned familiarity/prototype evidence and PF routing/backend-evolution evidence remain separate mechanisms with explicit ancestry links.
cross_source_reconciliation.architecture_implication: Fuse the reusable mechanisms at H1 rather than restoring any historical stack verbatim.

reuse: Conditional-compute escalation and explicit route reason/confidence receipts.
Fast structured pre-generative evidence where it remains cheaper/more reliable than broad native vision.
Drive Retina prototype/centroid familiarity memory and frozen replay methodology.
Native Qwen vision as a deeper fallback/escalation surface, not familiarity authority.
Explicit visual-backbone version compatibility and migration/invalidation tests.
do_not_reuse_as_authority: Historical heuristic confidence threshold 0.55 as a current calibrated open-set threshold.
The source comment that about 90% of images avoid VLM as a measured current fact.
YOLO/OCR labels or NativeVision prose as sensor truth.
Any old visual backend as the fixed permanent backbone without current project-hardware measurement.
current_architecture_delta.recommended_discriminating_test: In H1, implement the owner-fixed MVC between reusable feature extraction and deep native vision. Replay recurring user-specific classes plus realistic near-neighbor/OOD negatives and compare: (A) frozen-head NativeVision-only, (B) historical-style cheap gate + NativeVision, (C) cheap gate + MVC-0 centroid + NativeVision. Measure known accuracy, open-set FPR/AUROC, calibration, route fraction, end-to-end latency/CPU/RAM, sequential retention and backbone-version migration behavior.
